rules.description: scx_layered must be loadable without kernel recompilation (available binary or PPA)
CFS fallback must work transparently if sched_ext fails
Layer mapping: L0=REALTIME, L1=LATENCY_SENSITIVE, L2=THROUGHPUT, L3-L6=DEFAULT
scx daemon must consume <1% CPU when idle
All layer cgroup paths must be under agentic-workload.slice
